name: @zframes/provider-metals
description: Free keyless zframes data provider for precious and industrial metals: live spot (gold-api.com), the LBMA's daily London fix history back to 1968, weekly CFTC Commitments-of-Traders positioning in both the legacy and disaggregated reports, the U.S. Treasury's official gold reserve, gold-backed tokens, and Cboe's commodity implied-volatility indices (metal-spot, metal-history, metal-positioning, gold-reserve, tokenized-gold, commodity-vol-index capabilities).
author: Zentry
